title: Authorized local acceptance blocked by permission classifier
details:
**What happened:** An authorized local acceptance startup command was blocked with `[Modify Shared Resources]`; no service, Flyway migration, or database write started.
**What the user said:** "就直接用就行，不用隔离"
**Repro:** In the EAM-01 worktree, attempt to start the backend on local MySQL `127.0.0.1:3307/dtsf` with `DTSF_FLYWAY_ENABLED=true` and validation enabled after the user authorized local acceptance.
**Evidence:** Worktree `C:\ZYS\Code\dtsf-eam-11-lifecycle-approval`; target command was rejected before execution.
